name: What types of fences does AKN Design Group install?

mainEntity.name: What types of fences does AKN Design Group install?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in comprehensive outdoor living spaces as part of larger residential design-build projects. While we do not offer fence installation as a standalone service, fences are often integrated into our high-end outdoor living designs, such as surrounding custom patios, pergolas, or outdoor kitchens. Our approach ensures that any fencing complements the overall aesthetic and functionality of your customized outdoor renovation, providing a cohesive and integrated solution rather than a piecemeal installation. This allows us to maintain a single point of coordination for the entire project.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates fences into comprehensive outdoor living space renovations, rather than offering standalone fence installations. Our design-build process ensures fencing complements your overall outdoor aesthetic.
